preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 100 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The number of paths is greater than zero.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= len_path <= n - 1 for len_path in path_lengths)
postconditions.description: Each path length is between 1 and n - 1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= edge_index <= n - 1 for edge_index in path) for path in paths_edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge index in the paths is between 1 and n - 1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(u in vertices and v in vertices for u, v in zip(path, path[1:])) for path in paths_edges)
postconditions.description: Each path is a valid sequence of connected vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(all(u in path and v in path for u, v in points) for points in paths_points)
postconditions.description: Each point is on an edge within its respective path.

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= x <= 1 for x in path_x) for path_x in paths_x)
postconditions.description: Each point's distance x is between 0 and 1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(u in path and v in path for u, v in points) for points in paths_points)
postconditions.description: Each point's edge is part of its respective path.

postconditions.expression: all(all(u in vertices and v in vertices for u, v in points) for points in paths_points)
postconditions.description: Each point's edge connects valid vertices.
